justifications.D1: "mark quantities predating their source claim as 'metadata_incomplete'; do not flag these as misaligned, only as unverifiable" — assumption-auditing guards exist, but the summary's circular-derivation failure mode (columns computed under the tested conjecture) is never explicitly quarantined.
justifications.D3: "If ≥2 metrics with documented fail-dangerous or measurement-bias sources lack paired regulators ... the audit FAILS" — >=2 numeric count thresholds plus phase stopping rules, but no cheap early hypothesis-killing falsifier.
justifications.D4: "Null ledger: Run the same audit against a synthetic ledger with random quantity values" — at least one confound isolated by design, but the summary's known circularity confound has no concrete element.
justifications.D5: "no automated check flagged this reversal for dependent calculations" — a clearly new internal-audit question, without an explicit statement of the new empirical cell.
justifications.D6: "halt and report 'insufficient structured quantity–claim binding to proceed'" — the misaligned vs aligned hypotheses get different predicted flag counts, but a zero-flag outcome has no pre-committed reading.

justifications.D1: "rank ≥2 results are reported only as 'internal table consistency,' never as 'BSD verification'" — the circularity failure mode is converted into the perturbation-injection discriminator (predictions 2-3, F2).
justifications.D3: "F4: HALT before scaling if independent re-derivation of 'every distinct sha_an is a perfect square' ... produces any counterexample" — a cheap early mechanism-independent falsifier plus numeric F1-F3 and a staged stopping rule.
justifications.D4: "Positive control: hand-verified famous curves (step 1) — validates the arithmetic itself" plus the perturbation negative control — the summary's confounds each addressed and the instrument's detection power is demonstrated.
justifications.D5: "A naive whole-table audit of this identity will report a near-universal 'pass,' but that pass is largely tautological on the rank ≥ 2 stratum" — states the non-circular-stratum cell it adds beyond the full-table prior.
justifications.D6: "the (expected) failure to catch them on rank ≥2 is itself the key measured output, not noise to be explained away" — every branch pre-committed, including NOT_ESTABLISHED when provenance metadata is absent.

justifications.D1: "For curves with rank ≤ 2 (high confidence in the BSD formula accuracy), compute the LHS of BSD (Sha_an × Reg × prod c_p)" — the design uses conjecture-derived sha_an as a verification endpoint; the circularity failure mode is never mentioned, and the rank restriction (motivated by formula confidence, not provenance) still includes the contaminated stratum.
justifications.D3: "F1 — rank-regulator consistency (fatal): Any curve with rank=0 and regulator > 0.001 ... Count: 0 allowed" — a cheap early logic-level falsifier plus numeric F2-F5 and a staged stopping rule with hard stops on F1/F2.
justifications.D4: "pre-register the normalization standard before the audit begins" — several relevant confounds (population, normalization, staleness) are isolated, but the summary's known circularity confound has no concrete element.
justifications.D5: "No existing audit loop was found in the codebase that systematically re-verifies stored derived quantities against their conjectures" — a new storage-integrity question, without an explicit new-cell statement.
justifications.D6: "If F1 or F2 fails ... This signals a tool-level error in prometheus_math ... not a schema-level issue" — most failure branches route to distinct conclusions, but a pass cannot be distinguished from tautological consistency when sha_an is back-solved, so not every branch is distinct.

justifications.D1: "a back-solved row MUST show near-zero residual by construction, and if it doesn't, the provenance tag itself is untrustworthy" — circularity is converted into the Phase-0 provenance split with F3 validating the classifier itself.
justifications.D3: "F1: if ... fewer than 30 joinable rows in any single object family, the family is DECLARED UNTESTABLE" — cheap early independent falsifiers (F1-F3) plus numeric F4/F5 and phase-wise stopping verdicts.
justifications.D4: "the true-paired residual distribution's median is not below the 5th percentile of the shuffled-pairing residual distribution" — every summary confound addressed plus canary and permutation checks demonstrating the statistic can detect real pairing signal.
justifications.D5: "the audit's first job is to separate these two populations before scoring anything" — a defensible superseding extension of the consistency audit, but the prior full-table result is not explicitly positioned as the cell being superseded.
justifications.D6: "a structural zero is not evidence of agreement" — UNTESTABLE / DESIGN-INVALID / INSTRUMENT-BROKEN verdicts plus first-class coverage accounting pre-commit every branch including the vacuous reading.
